title: LaunchVideo (shipvideo)
what_it_does: URL or prompt in, launch video out via an Opus-driven agent that writes one HTML film and renders it under a virtual clock on a hosted sandbox.
when_to_use: Only as a reference for a hosted URL-to-video flow and a check_scene idea (dump visible text at several timestamps).

source.licence: NONE (no LICENSE file; GitHub reports no licence)

why: No licence means all rights reserved, so no code is copied. It also depends on a paid hosted platform (OpenComputer) and does not use HyperFrames.
